soil_organic_carbon_pct.notes: Agricultural soils often range 0.5–4% SOC. The 4 per 1000 initiative treats even small annual SOC gains as climatically and biologically meaningful (Minasny et al. 2017). Semi-arid cultivated soils below ~0.5% have severely impaired microbial habitat (FAO 2017).

ph.notes: Most soil bacteria, nutrient cycling enzymes, and temperate crops perform best near pH 6.0–7.5. Below 5.5, Al/Mn toxicity and P fixation increase; above ~8.3, micronutrient availability collapses (Brady & Weil; FAO soils).

native_cover_pct.notes: Landscape-scale biodiversity and pollination often decline sharply when semi-natural habitat falls below ~10–20% of the mosaic (Dainese et al. 2019; Haddad et al. 2015).
